text:
We’re sorry to hear you felt unsupported after a problem involving your companion animal during travel. In response to your complaint, we want to acknowledge what you experienced and explain how Aurelia Skyways handles companion animal care end to end.

First, we are truly sorry for the stress this caused you and Harley. Our team takes your pet’s well-being seriously, and that starts before departure. Passengers receive clear guidance so you know what to expect, how carriers are handled, and what steps we take to keep movement calm and careful.

When transfers happen between services, a ground team moves carriers with care and attention to timing and handling. We know that any disruption can feel unsettling, so we use a stepwise escalation process when something does not go as planned. That escalation is designed to keep reviews calm and thorough, with the right coordinator bringing the issue forward quickly, and with careful documentation so nothing gets lost between handoffs.

Regarding your claim filing timing, escape in transit has a deadline of 59 days, which means you must submit your claim within that window.

If you already contacted the desk, please know we will review everything connected to your booking and the pet’s handling. If you have not yet submitted your paperwork, we recommend doing so as soon as possible so the case can be processed with the time window in mind. Our goal is not only to confirm details, but to provide a clear outcome and respectful communication throughout.

We understand how frustrating it is when you are trying to advocate for your animal in transit. If there are any additional details you remember, such as the exact points where the issue began or any observations you made during the journey, sharing them will help the team assess the situation accurately.

Thank you for taking the time to write. We appreciate the chance to make this right, and we will continue working through the issue with a calm, care-first approach.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
